payload.title: Plotting_Raw_Data
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook demonstrates how to plot raw paleoclimate data using the Pyleoclim library. It begins by importing necessary packages such as pickle, matplotlib.pyplot, and pyleoclim. The notebook then loads data from serialized files, including plotting series, color maps, and marker dictionaries. Finally, it plots the data using a predefined order of records from various geographic locations.

section_blurbs.blurb: The notebook outlines the process of plotting raw paleoclimate data using Pyleoclim. It imports necessary libraries, loads data from pickle files, and visualizes the data using matplotlib.
section_blurbs.heading: Plotting Raw Data with Pyleoclim
